answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because reef only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. In practice crystal is enforced by the ledger itself: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any shale approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
